shortDescription: Brazilian planemaker Embraer BMFBOVESPA:EMBJ3 announced on Thursday it signed an agreement to deliver eight additional E190-E2 jets for Japan's ANA Holdings TSE:9202, which expands the 2025 firm order to 23 units of the commercial aircraft.
